title: My night in NYC with MomTok @secretlivesonhulu Season 3 is out NOW! #...
transcript: Come with me to follow my butt in front of Momtok at the Season 3 premiere party for The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. The night started at the rink at Rockefeller Center, where we literally got momtok scarves and the entire rink rented out for us to go skating, and I literally felt like I was Buddy the elf with Joey on a date. We were. We're doing Tik Toks. I was trying to do tricks pretending like I was in Disney on ice, but I literally just kept falling. Mom talk and dad talk were both out on the ice with us, and I just kept asking my friend Ashley, will mom talk survive us? Because we were just having so much fun, feeling like we are in our own movie starring this Secret lives of Mormon Wives. They then brought us to the Plaza Hotel, and I have never been inside the Plaza Hotel at Christmas time, and I literally felt like what Kevin Mccallister must have felt like in A Home Alone, too. But it was even more magical than I dreamed it would be. We got to make ornaments. Don't look, mom. That's for you for Christmas. We took pictures, and then we literally just got to hang out with mom Todd. I've truly never been to a premiere like this where hanging out with the talent just felt so authentic and genuine and real. Like, we just got to watch them take their gorgeous Photos. Meet the Love Thy Neighbor cast who showed up. But then my favorite part was just actually getting to form amazing connections with these women and then with these men as well, just talking and chatting it up with them, helping them out with their content. It truly just felt like I was hanging out and making tik toks with my best friends who I hadn't seen in a while, and that never happens at premieres like this. So I am so thankful and grateful to the Hulu team into the cast of Secret Lives of Mormon Wives for your kindness, and I cannot wait to binge season 3.
